source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: Where to Find All Human-Faced Banyan Trees (Heart of the Banyan)
source_excerpt:
Human-Faced Banyan Trees in Phantom Blade Zero are challenges where you must fight through several waves of enemies before facing a specific boss. Completing these challenges rewards you with a Banyan Heart , which is used to unlock certain skills in the skill tree. There are five Banyan Trees in total, and finding them all will complete the Heart of the Banyan quest.
If you die during a challenge, you will respawn right next to the Banyan Tree and can continue from the last wave or boss fight, making subsequent attempts shorter. The guide below covers the location of every Banyan Tree and the bosses you will encounter inside each one.
Quick Hand Zhang also sells Banyan Hearts whenever you find him in a new region, so check out his wares as well.
All Human-Faced Banyan Tree Locations in Phantom Blade Zero
From the Burial Ground Bell, make your way south across the map to the Parting Mists Bell. Continue further south from this location to find the first Banyan Tree.
Progress through the main story until you reach the Lion Dance Hall Bell. From here, head west to spot the Banyan Tree in the distance.
After using the Mandate Encampment Outer Gate Key and reaching the Sunset Path Bell in this region, ignore the main path straight ahead and head right. You will find the Banyan Tree near some enemies.
Once you have the boat and can explore Meigu Lake, make your way east to find the Lake Banyan Dock area. The Banyan Tree is located in the middle.
After finding and using the Shrine Gate Key, follow the straight path ahead to reach the final Banyan Tree.
All Banyan Tree Bosses in Phantom Blade Zero
Each Human-Faced Banyan Tree challenge ends with the following boss encounters:
Pangzhen: Master Bi Yuan of the Tianxuan Sect
Mandate Encampment: Stone Hand Iron Fever and Iron Fiend, Young Mistress's Guardian
Meigu Lake: Cavalrybane, Elite Shadow Warrior and Soulclaimer, Elite Shadow Warden
Mountain of Imprisonment: Jagged Steel, the Frenzied Brute and Iron Butcher, the Frenzied Brute
